# Adam Jaro

> Adam Jaro is a creative director based in London. He builds brands, campaigns and the creative teams behind them, mostly in startups and scale-ups. He is currently Creative Lead at Kooth Digital Health.

## About (in Adam's words)

I'm a creative director in London. I got into this because I love making things, and ten years on I still do.

Most of my career has been in startups and scale-ups, usually as one of the first creative hires, working directly with the founder or CMO. I also co-founded Social Custard, an agency that worked with Emilia Wickstead and the Royal Albert Hall.

Now I'm Creative Lead at Kooth Digital Health: a company-wide brand refresh, national campaigns (including an award-winning one with The Diana Award), and the pitch and board decks most creative directors never touch.

The job is the same wherever I am: set a clear creative bar, build the team and process that can hit it at speed, and stay hands-on enough to show what good looks like. I design, I direct, and I build things too. This site included, with Claude Code.

## Experience

- Creative Lead, Kooth Digital Health (2024 to now)
- Co-founder & Creative Director, Social Custard (2023 to 2025)
- Head of Production, MindLabs (2021 to 2022)
- Creative Lead / Lead Video Producer, Fiit (2018 to 2020)
- Senior Creative Producer, Qubit (2018)
- Founder & Creative Director, Soundlikejaro (2014 to now)

## What he does

- Creative direction & brand strategy
- Brand identity & systems
- Integrated campaigns: TV, OOH, digital, social
- Performance creative & paid social
- Building and leading creative teams
- Pitch, investor & board materials
- AI-assisted design and build

## Selected clients and brands

Kooth, The Diana Award, Royal Albert Hall, Emilia Wickstead, Fiit, MindLabs, Channel 4, The FA, Hussle, British Soft Drinks Association, The Trouble Club, UCL, Sephora, L’Occitane

## Work

- [The Pretender](https://adamjaro.com/projects/the-pretender/): campaign film for Kooth x The Diana Award. Kooth's own research found that one in three young people who are bullied don't tell anyone at home. Results: Winner, Brand Film Awards 2026; Featured on ITV, with coverage across national press; Ran nationally across digital OOH.
- [Your Move](https://adamjaro.com/projects/your-move/): youth mental health campaign for Kooth. Mental health campaigns aimed at teenagers tend to sound the same, and teenagers tune them out. Results: Rolled out nationally across schools, digital and social; Put printed materials and activations in front of tens of thousands of students; Gave Kooth a more confident voice with young people.
- [Join the mental health revolution](https://adamjaro.com/projects/join-the-mental-health-revolution/): launch film for MindLabs. MindLabs was a mental wellbeing app launching into a crowded, soft-focus category. Results: Anchored the brand and app launch across every channel; Used extensively across paid social and performance campaigns.
- [Bring the gym home](https://adamjaro.com/projects/bring-the-gym-home/): national TV ad for Fiit. When the first lockdown hit, every home fitness app was suddenly chasing the same people. Results: Aired nationally for over three months at the peak of lockdown demand; Contributed to a surge in sign-ups.
- [The light show](https://adamjaro.com/projects/the-light-show/): influencer event for British Soft Drinks Association. The British Soft Drinks Association wanted younger audiences to take a fresh look at low- and no-sugar drinks. Results: Sold-out event with around 30 creators; Hundreds of organic posts across creators' own channels; A library of content for BSDA's owned channels from a single day.
- [Together, we create the amazing](https://adamjaro.com/projects/together-we-create-the-amazing/): fundraising film for Royal Albert Hall America. Royal Albert Hall America raises money from US donors to support the Hall's work. Results: The flagship film for RAHA's US fundraising; A versatile asset for engaging high-value US donors; Presents the Hall as both historic and forward-looking.
- [London fashion week SS24](https://adamjaro.com/projects/london-fashion-week-ss24/): show livestream for Emilia Wickstead. Emilia Wickstead wanted their SS24 London Fashion Week show to reach far beyond the people in the room, and to feel as considered on screen as it did on the... Results: Livestreamed to thousands beyond the live audience; A full suite of show films and social edits for Emilia Wickstead's channels.
- [Hussle x Fiit](https://adamjaro.com/projects/hussle-x-fiit/): partnership launch film for Hussle x Fiit. Fiit partnered with Hussle so members could train with the Fiit app in any Hussle gym. Results: Launched the partnership to both user bases; A creative framework Fiit could reuse beyond this launch; Reinforced Fiit's position as the fitness app you can use anywhere.
- [Here comes trouble](https://adamjaro.com/projects/here-comes-trouble/): brand campaign for Trouble Club. The Trouble Club is a community and talks organisation for women. Results: A refreshed, more energetic brand across the club's digital channels; Greater appeal to the younger audience the club wanted to reach; A flexible asset library the team could keep using.
- [Unwind](https://adamjaro.com/projects/unwind/): breathwork and meditation series for MindLabs. At MindLabs, content was the product as well as the marketing. Results: Two flagship series in the MindLabs app; Gave the content library a distinct identity in a crowded category.

## Side projects (Lab)

- [Flauna](https://flauna.app) (live): Daily flora & fauna trivia. One species a day, the same for everyone.
- FM synth (in progress): A daily puzzle on a four-track FM synth. A pocket synth with four tracks: bass, keys, lead and drums.
- [Clam Sync](https://clamsync.com) (live): Drop a folder, get a synced timeline. A Mac and Windows app for video editors.

More: https://adamjaro.com/lab/
